data.title: Architecture Best Practice: Agentic Context Engineering (ACE) — Evolving Playbooks, Incremental Delta Updates, and Context Collapse Defense
data.description: Comprehensive OKF architecture blueprint for Agentic Context Engineering (ACE, ICLR 2026): Generator-Reflector-Curator division of labor, itemized playbook bullets with helpful/harmful credit counters, non-LLM incremental delta merging, Grow-and-Refine semantic deduplication, and KV-cache-friendly context evolution.
